name: Plainstrider Menace
summary: East of the Crossroads, plainstriders threaten the outpost’s food stores. Sergra Darkthorn sends new Horde arrivals to hunt them, giving the newcomers their first measure of the Barrens.

sections.title: Securing the Crossroads
sections.body: The Crossroads coordinates supplies across Kalimdor. Now plainstriders east of the outpost are picking at its food crates. Sergra Darkthorn, an orc shaman, sends newly arrived Horde adventurers to hunt the birds before they damage the stores. The settlement depends on those provisions.

sections.title: The First Hunt
sections.body: Sergra Darkthorn uses the hunt to test newcomers and protect the settlement’s supplies. To her, plainstriders are simple prey, fit to teach young hunters to endure the elements and track quarry across the sun-baked plains. Bringing back their sharp beaks shows patience and the basic martial skill needed to face fiercer beasts of the Barrens.

faq.answer: Plainstriders east of the Crossroads have grown bold, raiding food supplies and harassing passing supply lines. Sergra Darkthorn orders the hunt to protect the settlement’s provisions.

Sergra Darkthorn is an experienced orc shaman stationed at the Crossroads. She oversees hunting trials, trains incoming adventurers, and directs them against wild beasts that threaten Horde operations.

faq.q: Why does Sergra want their beaks specifically?
faq.answer: A plainstrider uses its tough, sharp beak as its main weapon and a tool for scavenging. Bringing back the beak proves the bird has been slain.
After the plainstriders, Sergra sends you to hunt zhevra, faster and more spirited prey roaming the plains.
Plainstriders roam the savanna grasslands east and southeast of the Crossroads, foraging along the trade roads.

faq.q: Is this part of a larger hunting series?
faq.answer: Yes. This begins Sergra Darkthorn’s hunting trials in the Barrens. The trials grow more dangerous as they turn to fiercer beasts across the savanna.

angles.text: As a young hunter, you learn to stalk, track, and bring down quarry in the wide-open savanna.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect the Crossroads, a vital supply junction, and secure its food so the Horde can hold its ground across Kalimdor.
As an orc, you honor the discipline of the hunt. Sergra expects you to prove your mettle against local beasts before taking on weightier duties.
